Question
========
What kind of information may appear in the Frequently Asked Questions section of a DMP?

Answerlist
----------
* Citation preferences
* Methods of data gathering
* Expected revenue of the project
* code of conduct of data usage


Solution
========
The Frequently Asked Questions section may include citation preferences and backup methods.

Answerlist
----------
* True
* False
* False
* False
